entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent UI currency illustration for an original dark fantasy hand-painted action RPG. Primary request: one compact small treasure-discovery pile of thick ancient GOLD COINS, isolated on genuine transparent alpha, no frame, no backdrop. Subject: about 12 heavy irregular antique gold coins naturally overlapping in a low broad pile, two short uneven stacks at the back and three loose coins leaning in the front, viewed from a close three-quarter angle, revealing substantial metal thickness and finely notched edges. Each visible coin face has sculpted ancient dragon or crown relief and subtle abstract engraving, with worn raised rims, little nicks and dark patina in the recesses. The front coin should be especially readable with a bold carved dragon profile. Style: premium detailed painterly fantasy inventory art, convincing dimensional metal and artisanal carving, rich amber gold shadows, warm gold reflections and narrow bright pale-gold highlights, treasure newly discovered in a dungeon. Compact cohesive silhouette readable at 48 and 72 pixels. Composition: centered single asset on a square 1024x1024 canvas, pile fills roughly 76 percent width and 55 percent height, fully visible with clear transparent padding around it. Lighting: controlled warm light from upper left, subtle dark contact shading only between coins, no cast ground plane. Background MUST be truly transparent with alpha zero in all empty areas, no black or white rectangular plate. Avoid: star shapes, star symbols, generic circle-and-star icon, dollar/euro/currency symbols, modern money logos, text, letters, numbers, cartoon smile, money bag, treasure chest, gems, confetti, glowing halo, magical circle, floor, scenery, watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent victory heraldic ornament for the top of a dark fantasy action RPG result panel. Primary request: one beautifully crafted THREE-DIMENSIONAL ANTIQUE GOLD VICTORY CREST, isolated on genuine transparent alpha, WITHOUT WORDS. Subject: a regal five-point metal crown with substantial dimensional sculpting and three small deep crimson gemstones, centered above a pair of crossed narrow steel swords with dark-gold engraved hilts. Two elegant sculpted gold laurel branches rise upward at either side, their separate leaves forming an OPEN V silhouette rather than a closed circle. Beneath the crown is a compact pointed blackened-metal shield with rich engraved gold filigree and a raised ornamental blade motif, not a star. The swords cross behind the shield, their distinct tips rise left and right behind the crown. A short folded wine-red velvet ribbon passes behind the lower shield, with blank surfaces and pointed tails. Style: premium painterly dark fantasy game UI, exquisite aged metal craftsmanship, hand-sculpted bevels, dark recesses and warm gold edge highlights; crisp clean silhouette, tasteful controlled ornament, noble victory rather than bright toy trophy. Fine detail at large size but main crown/sword/laurel shapes readable at 96 pixels. Composition: a single centered crest on square 1024x1024 canvas, fully visible, about 78 percent canvas width and height with generous genuinely transparent padding on all sides. Lighting: dimensional top-left warm key light and cool steel reflections, no diffuse glow halo, no cast ground plane. Background fully transparent alpha zero, absolutely no colored backdrop. Avoid: circular badge frame, ring around a star, star shapes anywhere, flat vector glyph, CSS-looking shapes, modern logo, human figure, text, letters, numbers, banners containing words, confetti, giant wings, scenery, white rectangle, black rectangle, watermark.
